author.name: ハカセ アイ(Ai-Hakase)🐾生成AI・ComfyUI

summary_md: **ハカセ アイ(Ai-Hakase)🐾生成AI・ComfyUI ([@ai_hakase_](https://x.com/ai_hakase_/status/2116048964470325266))** covers **Qwenputer**, which compiles a 32-bit RISC-V CPU into 11 layers inserted into Qwen3.5-4B's weights, reusing Gated DeltaNet state as RAM so C or MicroPython runs inside the forward pass, scoring well on DeepMind arithmetic ([write-up](https://divagr.com/blog/qwenputer), [model](https://huggingface.co/divagr1925/Qwen3.5-4B-Qwenputer), [Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/LocalLLaMA/comments/1xhmo1q/someone_built_a_32bit_riscv_cpu_directly_inside/)).

referenced_urls.title: Qwenputer: a fully functioning, deterministic RISC-V CPU inside Qwen3.5
From the LocalLLaMA community on Reddit: Someone built a 32-bit RISC-V CPU directly inside Qwen's model weights so it can execute instructions internaly!

relevance: Deterministic computation embedded in a small local model.
